# Reconcile synthetic records — applied workshop

You support a synthetic reconciliation desk. Flag mismatches and draft a reason-coded review memo.

## Concept setup · 10 minutes
Compare amounts against a defined tolerance and send exceptions to reviewers. A matching amount is not proof of legitimacy; a mismatch is not proof of fraud. No investment or lending advice is produced.

## Implementation · 20 minutes
Return IDs whose observed amount differs from expected by more than 0.01. These are review candidates, not proven misconduct. Open the starter notebook or visual workflow simulator.

## Task · 20 minutes
Flag mismatches and draft a reason-coded review memo. Record a normal, missing-input and human-review case.

## Research and discussion · 15 minutes
Compare with a peer, cite your reading and identify a failure condition.

## Wrap-up · 5 minutes
Explain why a simulation is not a production-ready system; name the accountable owner.

## Submission
Draft cohort policy: 2–3-page APA-style paper with relevant code, output screenshots and citations. Word/PDF upload and Sunday 11:59 PM deadline need a scheduled cohort; no live deadline is set.

## Integrity
AI coaching on concepts and ungraded practice is allowed with disclosure. Graded reasoning must be your own.
